name: 指尖MUD
group_note: extracted from a nested zip inside zjmud.7z (指间mud服务器+手机版客户端.zip), internally folder-named 'hell' -- unrelated to the existing hell/zjdywzb Century family, distinct master-hash. Fixed efun::message() exc_target=0 rejection; created missing /log/nosave dir. Same shujian3-lineage mobile-app protocol and custom logind.lpc. Full WASM pass needed: (1) crypt(ZJKEY, 0) client-handshake non-determinism (AGENTS.md §7.14) -- fixed to crypt(ZJKEY, "zj"), same as zjdyzj; unlike shujian3, this lib's crypt-based ciphertext check in get_user() is NOT commented out and there's no comma-to-║ convenience replacement, so registration requires literal ║ separators and a real id/password ciphertext (crypt(ZJKEY,id)+crypt(ZJKEY,password)); (2) is_chinese() classic GBK byte-range check (§8.1) fixed to CJK codepoint range; (3) is_killing() object-vs-string arg mismatch in clone/user/user.lpc's accept_kill() (§7.50, third lineage to hit this); (4) three pure-socket daemons gutted per §7.52 (versiond.lpc -- 12 functions across create/in_server/connect_server/send_command/etc, NOT left "as-is" as the previous note said, since it was actually breaking questd.lpc's collect_all_quest_information() at runtime; payd.lpc HTTP payment callback; adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc intermud UDP layer). Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist. score is correctly gated behind a 'born' flag for freshly-created characters (game design, not a bug) -- verified look+quit instead.
